The codebase map is built at commit `8acf17d` (`8acf17dcca28036fa99cf09408e3646901d6add1`).

- **Areas mapped (14 of 14):** api, .claude, docs, e2e, .github, repository root (`*` + `public/`), scripts, src (top level), src/app, src/features, src/graphql, src/lib, src/mocks, src/ui. Every draft passed validation on the first attempt, so none needed a retry.
- **Areas not covered:** none.
- **INDEX.md:** 56 lines, at `docs/codebase-map/INDEX.md`. The area pages are in `docs/codebase-map/areas/`.

Reminders:
- Review `docs/codebase-map/` and commit it yourself. `.build/` has its own `.gitignore`, so it stays out of commits.
- Use `/ravn-agents:ask-codebase` to query the map. Don't add an `@docs/codebase-map` import to CLAUDE.md, because imports load at every launch. A one-line pointer there is fine.
- A `SessionStart` hook will tell you when areas go stale. Refresh them with `/ravn-agents:onboard --refresh`.
